metadata.question: Were there fires visible in a 50 mile radius around (latitude: 34.498828, longitude: -112.246886) between June 20, 2017 and June 30, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS fire products (e.g., FIRMS data via MODIS/VIIRS) - Best collection: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily fire product) or "FIRMS" (active fire data) - Actually, GEE has "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" and "MODIS/061/MOD14A1" for thermal anomalies/fire - Date: June 20-30, 2017 - Location: Point (34.498828, -112.246886) with 50-mile buffer (≈80.5 km) 2. Masking strategy: - Fire products have confidence bands - use high/nominal confidence fires - Check FireMask or MaxFRP bands - No cloud masking needed for fire detection 3. Logic: - If collection is empty → C1 - If fires detected (pixel count > 0 or max fire value > 0) → A (Yes) - If no fires detected → B (No) - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const centerPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.246886, 34.498828]); const radius = 50 * 1609.34; // 50 miles to meters const aoi = centerPoint.buffer(radius); const startDate = '2017-06-20'; const endDate = '2017-06-30'; console.log('Searching for fires within 50 miles of (34.498828, -112.246886)'); console.log('Date range: June 20-30, 2017'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try MODIS 061 version or VIIRS fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi); const fallbackSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback collection size: ${fallbackSize}`); if (fallbackSize === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for this period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Processing - Check for fire detections // FireMask band: 0-9 scale, values >= 7 indicate fires with varying confidence const fireMask = fireCollection.select('FireMask').max(); // Count fire pixels (value >= 7 indicates fire) const firePixels = fireMask.gte(7); const stats = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const fireCount = stats.FireMask; // Also check MaxFRP (Fire Radiative Power) for additional validation const maxFRP = fireCollection.select('MaxFRP').max(); const frpStats = maxFRP.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxFirePower = frpStats.MaxFRP; console.log(`Fire pixels detected: ${fireCount || 0}`); console.log(`Max Fire Radiative Power: ${maxFirePower || 0} MW`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (fireCount === null && maxFirePower === null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (fireCount > 0 || maxFirePower > 0) { console.log('Fires were detected in the area during this period.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No fires detected in the area during this period.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
